scope: Frame 0 only. Original 640x360 compositing shown beside intersection baseline on dark and blue; original-pixel selected area enlarged 4x nearest-neighbor. No full-240 candidate exists for these sample variants.

sample_variants.label: closed-form Alpha plus ML foreground estimate
sample_variants.finding: Against blue, the outer hair and ear contours become reddish/purple and soft; the original dark linework is visibly weakened relative to the intersection baseline. Preserving deep foreground face pixels does not establish that the foreground contour is preserved.

sample_variants.label: same closed-form Alpha plus unchanged original RGB
sample_variants.finding: The red edge shift is reduced, but side hair loops and outer ear contours remain gray/soft and locally lose dark outline contrast. Blue background visibly bleeds through these contour regions. This is an Alpha/contour preservation problem, so unchanged RGB alone is not a pass.

limitations: Only frame 0 was reviewed; no claim about temporal stability of this one-frame experiment.
No new 240-frame codec or Alpha inspection was performed for these non-final sample-only variants.
Face and lace core retention is a partial improvement, not whole-character edge approval.
